tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in to Lagos Life. Call session_status first; use login only if not already signed in. Collect lagoslife_username and lagoslife_password via emit_display interaction_mode input (pipeline_name login) after preview permission — never ask for password in chat text. Password is used only for the gam

tools.name: register
tools.description: Create a new Lagos Life account (sign-up). Use for operator broadcast accounts: username must start with announcement (3–20 letters, numbers, or _). Collect password via emit_display input. On success, session cookies are set; store credentials in tenant globals / broadcast account registry.

tools.name: change_username
tools.description: Rename the signed-in Lagos Life account (POST /api/auth/username). Requires current password. Many announcement* names return taken/reserved; prefer register with an available name.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Check whether you are signed in and which character you are playing as.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Load your sim profile: avatar, bio, and account details from the game.

tools.name: list_map_homes
tools.description: Browse the city map: every home plot, who lives there, who is online, and who is at home (Lekki, Yaba, Ikoyi, and other areas).

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List players saved in your in-game Phone contacts.

tools.name: list_dm_threads
tools.description: List your recent private message conversations from the in-game Phone app.

tools.name: get_chat_with_player
tools.description: Open one private chat and read the back-and-forth messages with another player.

tools.name: get_daily_rewards
tools.description: See today’s daily login rewards and streak for your sim.

tools.name: get_forbes_leaderboard
tools.description: See the in-game Forbes list of the richest Lagos Life players.

tools.name: get_wallet_pending
tools.description: Check pending wallet top-ups or purchases for your account.

tools.name: get_wallet_and_job
tools.description: See your in-game wallet balance in naira, your current job, and how your sim is doing.

tools.name: list_job_careers
tools.description: See available careers in the Jobs app (Tech, Banking, Music). Switching jobs is done in-game on your phone.

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find another player by username, like using Find a player on the in-game Phone.

tools.name: get_home_catalog
tools.description: List neighbour homes you can visit (GET /api/homes). Not the furniture shop — use get_furniture_catalog for Buy mode items.

tools.name: get_furniture_catalog
tools.description: Buy mode furniture and décor catalog with prices in ₦ (static list synced from the game client). Optional category or max price filter.

tools.name: get_home_layout
tools.description: Your current home: placed furniture grid positions, storage, decor score, and cash.

tools.name: list_neighbour_homes
tools.description: Neighbour homes you can visit (GET /api/homes). Alias of get_home_catalog.

tools.name: preview_home_design
tools.description: Before/after 3D preview: Before = player's save as-is; After = ONLY items you place via home_design_placements (type, x, y, rot per piece). No automatic layout. Call get_home_layout + get_furniture_catalog first. Returns preview_artifact_url and home_design_add_json for apply_home_design.

tools.name: propose_home_design
tools.description: Same as preview_home_design (legacy tool name). You supply home_design_placements; no automatic placement.

tools.name: get_decorator_job_layout
tools.description: Fetch a decorator job layout (GET /api/jobs?layout=). Apply via home_design_layout_json after user confirms.

tools.name: apply_home_design
tools.description: Apply home changes (PUT /api/save): add/buy, full layout, move, stow, or sell. Preview with emit_display (pipeline_name apply_home_design) first.

tools.name: get_crime_record
tools.description: Check your clean record, EFCC file, or police history in the game.

tools.name: report_to_police
tools.description: Report another player to in-game police (confirm details with the user first).

tools.name: free_wallet_topup
tools.description: Add in-game naira via GET/PUT /api/save (user-supplied amount). Always call session_status first; if not signed in, emit_display preview then input for login before this tool. Default 20000 if wallet_inflate_amount_ngn omitted; max applied 1000000000 per call (poc_free_wallet_topup.py). On STALE_SAV

tools.name: send_money
tools.description: Send in-game naira from your existing game balance to another player (POST /api/send). NOT a real-money top-up — use purchase_discounted_credits for Nova discounted wallet shop. Confirm recipient id and amount with the user first.

tools.name: send_dm
tools.description: Send one private text to another player through the in-game Phone (confirm message text with the user first).

tools.name: purchase_discounted_credits
tools.description: Open the discounted Lagos Life wallet shop (save up to 90% on wallet credit). Use when the player wants paid in-game wallet credits via bank transfer. They pick a pack in the HTML shop, then enter email and Lagos Life username on Nova checkout.

tools.name: map_online_stats
tools.description: Friendly summary of who is around the city map: totals online, at home, and counts by neighborhood.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-lagos_life" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_dm_threads, get_chat_with_player, purchase_discounted_credits · Private data: login, register, change_username, list_contacts, list_dm_threads, get_chat_with_player, get_wallet_pending, get_wallet_and_job, get_crime_record, free_wallet_topup, send_money, send_dm, purchase_discounted_credits · Public sink: register, change_username, send_money, send_dm, purchase_discounted_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_dm_threads, get_chat_with_player, purchase_discounted_credits · Private data: login, register, change_username, list_contacts, list_dm_threads, get_chat_with_player, get_wallet_pending, get_wallet_and_job, get_crime_record, free_wallet_topup, send_money, send_dm, purchase_discounted_credits · Public sink: register, change_username, send_money, send_dm, purchase_discounted_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
